correctness.rationale: At round one, the initial co-infected source survives independently for each pathogen with Bernoulli(s); all other pathogen-specific acquisitions are independent Bernoulli(p_j) fields because only one initial source makes r=2 group hazards inactive. At round two, present pathogens independently survive with probability s; absent pathogen acquisition averages U or V depending on presence of the other pathogen at round start. Enumerating four C1,C2 possibilities yields M=s²+(1-s)[(1-s)U+sV], J=s^4+2s²(1-s)V+(1-s)²U², and covariance J-M²=s(1-s)²(U-V)[2U-s(2+U-V)]. If the source has a positive-transmission neighbor then 0<U,V<1, U!=V exactly when alpha!=1; the bracket decreases across zero at unique s*=2U/(2+U-V) in (0,1). alpha=1 independence follows from identical independent pathogen-specific dynamics and deterministic initially independent configuration. An independently worked overlapping-triangle case gives U=319/512, V=25215/32768 and s*=40832/60737; checked verify.py independent exact enumerator. Scope is exactly source time 2, not global prevalence.
